qualitative.gate_3m_moat_note: Deep installer/electrician brand loyalty and mission-critical specifications create high switching costs. Products represent a minor cost fraction of building construction with high failure risks, granting reliable pricing power above inflation and ~14% GAAP ROIC (>100% tangible ROIC).
qualitative.note: Passes all 6 gates. Premier global specialist in electrical and digital building infrastructures, with fast-growing data center white space exposure (26% of sales). Highly disciplined execution under CEO Benoît Coquart delivering ~14% GAAP ROIC, >110% FCF conversion, and conservative ~2.7x net debt/NI. [5-10Y g: data center/white space electrical 3.5% + building renovation 1.5% + pricing power 1.5% + bolt-on M&A 1.0%]
qualitative.evidence: 4-year median GAAP ROIC is 13.98% (tangible ROIC >100% after adjusting for €10.2B in goodwill/intangibles). FY2025 net income reached €1,244.6M with Owner FCF of €1,328.1M (FCF conversion 114.6%). Net debt of €3,342.3M is ~2.69x net income, supported by €1,859M EBIT and 11.1x interest coverage. Fast-growing data center segment (26% of 2025 sales) benefits directly from AI compute expansion.
